Subject: Intro/demo - Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the intro — we'd love to take a look at Redwood's inference platform. We're trying to get a demo scheduled next week (Nov 17-21) to get an internal kickoff going, but wanted to flag a constraint: several of our platform and procurement folks will be at re:Invent the week of Nov 25-29, so we have a blackout window then and would prefer to line things up either before travel or after Nov 29.

Availability on our side (PST):
- Tue 11/18: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 11/19: 09:00–11:00
- Fri 11/21: afternoon less ideal

If those don't work, happy to push to the week of Dec 2. Also happy to do a 20–30 minute pre-demo with a smaller group if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Taylor
Senior Director, Cloud Platform
ACME Corp

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and for flagging the re:Invent blackout.

We can absolutely accommodate either a pre-demo next week or schedule the full demo for the week of Dec 2. Quick thoughts:
- If you want the broader procurement/infra group involved, Dec 2–5 (we have open slots) may be easier to get everyone aligned after travel.
- If you need a fast pre-demo to unblock technical discovery, we can do a 25-minute session Tue 11/18 at 10:30 PT. That would let us surface the high-level architecture and suggested rollout patterns.

I've looped in Marissa (CS) to help with any contractual/procurement questions and Jonas from our solutions team for the dedicated capacity discussion. What would you prefer?

Best,

Alex — great to confirm. Per our pre-demo earlier this morning, we heard the ask on procurement and have a short mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum:

1) Dec 2, 2025 — Full platform demo (60 minutes) — 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET — calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics).
2) Post-demo doc: pricing bands and reserved capacity options — Marissa will share an initial pricing sheet within 48 hours (attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf and pricing-template.xlsx).
3) Tech deep-dive: Jonas will follow up with a 30-minute session on dedicated capacity and quantization recommendations if you want a deeper look.

Attachment notes: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda + TL;DR), calendar-invite.ics (invite), pricing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet).

If anything changes because of travel or other conflicts in your group, please let us know — we can move the slot to Dec 3 or Dec 4 as a fallback. Looking forward to the demo.
